title: WebGPU Texture Arrays in Rust and wgpu
description: Draw seven textured quads with one WebGPU draw call. Learn Rust wgpu texture arrays, image resizing, instancing, WGSL layer selection, and texture filtering.
imageAlt: Seven tilted quads stacked on a dark background: a husky image, a bridge sky image, red, green, blue, and two colorful procedural patterns.
